title: Assessing the Potential Impact of a Pedibus Program on Urban Traffic Congestion: A Case Study of a Critical Intersection in the Municipality of Pitești
content: Urban traffic congestion in the vicinity of educational institutions is largely determined by the use of cars for school trips. The paper analyzes the impact of the implementation of the Pedibus program on the performance of an urban intersection in the municipality of Pitești, using real traffic data and microscopic modeling in the PTV Vissim environment. The results indicate that the intersection currently operates at service level F, with high delays and capacity overrun. The implementation of the Pedibus program, modelled through a reduction in school-related vehicle flows based on the school mobility survey and the assumed participation scenario, leads to improvements in intersection performance and a transition from LOS F to LOS E. The study highlights the effectiveness of mobility measures based on changing user behavior, demonstrating their potential to reduce congestion in school areas without major interventions on the infrastructure.
